label: defixs-finance.vercel.app
title: Defix-Finance | One-Stop DeFi Solution
reasons: Field named `seedPhrase` present in the bundled application code, rendered by an SPA whose HTML is an empty root div — the operator's own form field, not a library internal.
Social engineering copy offers to 'rectify all strange wallet issues' and perform 'ASSET RECOVERY' and 'CLAIM AIRDROP' as pretexts to harvest credentials from visitors with real wallet problems.
References real wallet brands — Trust Wallet, Coinbase Wallet, WalletConnect — in a fake recovery/repair context to build trust with visitors before the seed phrase prompt.
iocs: seedPhrase (form field targeting wallet seed phrases)

label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app
title: EVM Resolve
reasons: The page displays a wallet connection dialog impersonating Coinbase Wallet, prompting the user to connect their self-custody wallet or Coinbase account.

Multiple buttons for services like 'Validation' and 'Assets Recovery' all redirect to the same connection page (/connect/index.html), indicating the primary function is to harvest wallet connections under false pretenses.

The page includes deceptive technical measures: disabling right-click and keyboard shortcuts (F12, Ctrl+U) and using a script to remove all link hrefs and redirect clicks to the connection flow, preventing user inspection.

label: max-prox.github.io/infonikhil
title: bikes
reasons: The page silently collects comprehensive user fingerprinting data (IP, WebGL, audio fingerprint, etc.) without disclosure or consent.
Collected data is exfiltrated to a Telegram bot via a hardcoded bot token and chat IDs: 'sendToTelegram()' function POSTs to 'https://api.telegram.org/bot${botToken}/sendMessage'.
The page disguises this activity with a benign title 'bikes' and a redirect to YouTube, providing no indication of the data collection occurring.

label: xxxkkkll1234-collab.github.io/Tigerh

It directs users to deposit funds to a hardcoded wallet address (TUAbiNfLsWUPp6dyyTY3BteZdjKrMnD3gc) under the false premise of guaranteed investment returns.
It sends transaction details and withdrawal requests to a Telegram bot controlled by the operator, with no disclosure to the visitor.

label: max-prox.github.io/infonikhil2
title: info

label: mog4925-ui.github.io/ihgftr
title: تسجيل الدخول الاستمارة أونلاين
reasons: The page harvests bank login credentials via fields named 'account-num' (account number) and 'password' (password) and sends them to a Telegram bot: 'sendToTelegram` function transmits `الحساب المدخل: ${userData.accountNum}\n🔐 السر المدخل: ${userData.password}` to `api.telegram.org`.

The page collects comprehensive personal and banking security data (mother's name, security questions, OTP, salary, relative's account) under the pretext of 'iBOK' online banking services, with all data exfiltrated to the same Telegram bot.
The page impersonates the real banking service iBOK (Bank of Khartoum) by using its name and logo, and includes a fake WhatsApp support link (`wa.me/249902013790`) to appear legitimate.

label: chat-noir-md.vercel.app
title: 🖤 Chat Noir-MD | Pairing
reasons: The page has an input field named 'phoneInput' for collecting WhatsApp phone numbers.
It sends a POST request with the phone number to 'https://TON-URL-KATABUMP.com/api/pair', an external endpoint not affiliated with WhatsApp.
The visible copy claims to generate a WhatsApp pairing code for device linking, but the data is exfiltrated to a third-party server.
